Aisha (partnerships): need a quick decision: do we launch a private-offer commit promo bundled with HW rebates for the April marketplace push? owners + timing.
Marco (marketplace-sales): yes. propose two private-offer tiers (12mo/24mo) + appliance bundle SKU that attaches a HW rebate code. I'll draft SKU matrix.
Priya (legal): flag: non-stackability with marketplace coupons + clear activation/renewal definitions needed. will draft short boilerplate.
Ken (hw-partner): we can provide rebate codes to resellers, expiry 180 days. webhook available to post activations.
Riley (field-ops): ops needs test run Mar 28 and final runbook Apr 4 to meet Apr 15 announce.
announce-bot: draft-announcement: marketplace-bundle + hw-rebate pilot (target Apr 15) (status: draft)
Aisha (partnerships): actions: Marco -> SKU matrix by Mar 22; Priya -> legal snippet by Mar 24; Ken -> webhook + code cadence by Mar 21; Riley -> schedule tests. Risks: marketplace approval delays, credit reconciliation lag.
Marco (marketplace-sales): noted, adding fallback SKU mapping for manual credits. will post sheet link.
Priya (legal): drafting audit addendum for credit reconciliation.
Ken (hw-partner): will confirm batch size and send webhook schema EOD.
Riley (field-ops): scheduling now and creating runbook PR.
Aisha (partnerships): thanks, keep updates here.
